title: Young players coming up: Warren Vache
summary: Young players should get road experience; he predicts the not-yet-20 Warren Vache will be one of the good ones.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: There are lots of good guys around, even who are willing to go out and maybe travel and ...(?)..

Yes. I think... I don't mind... If a young guy can do it... It's okay for a young guy to do it, you know. Because you've got to have health and everything, and then you get experience, which you do need if you're going to play music.
Do you have a feeling that there are young musicians still coming up who are growing up and playing...
Do I know some good ones?

Oh yeah. There's one in particular that I know that he'll probably some-day be one of the good ones, and that's a guy named Warren Vache. I don't think he's 20 yet, you know, but he plays like mad. He's beautiful.
Yeah. I was surprised how much he had improved when I heard him.
I hadn't heard him in a couple of years.
Yeah. But he's sure gone at it. Now he sounds good. Very good.
So even though, you know, the music has moved off in a lot of different tangents, there's still like a basic core that will remain that young musicians will come up and they will still play.
Now, I'm not talking about Dixieland. I'm talking about Jazz, really.
